title: Expert L2 English Speech Evaluation on a Gaming PC: Accuracy, Fluency, and Prosody with XLS-R, XEUS, and PhoneticXeus
abstract: arXiv:2610.26406v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: oollim is a locally executable system for evaluating L2 English pronunciation accuracy, fluency, and prosody on a consumer computer. The system combines pretrained XLS-R, XEUS, and PhoneticXeus representations with reference-text features and ridge regressions trained on SpeechOcean762, the Korean Learners' L2 Speech Corpus (English), J-AESOP, and their combinations. On 305 independently held-out recordings assessed by three expert raters, several ridge configurations substantially outperform archival Microsoft Azure Pronunciation Assessment API data in both Spearman correlation and quadratic weighted kappa across all three constructs. These results support expert speech evaluation on consumer hardware using pretrained representations and construct-specific regressions, without neural-model fine-tuning or calibration on the private evaluation data.

translated_title: 在游戏电脑上实现专家级二语英语语音评估：基于XLS-R、XEUS和PhoneticXeus的准确性、流利度与韵律评价
translated_abstract: oollim 是一个可在消费级电脑上本地运行的系统，用于评估二语英语学习者的发音准确性、流利度和韵律。该系统将预训练的 XLS-R、XEUS 和 PhoneticXeus 表征与参考文本特征相结合，并使用在 SpeechOcean762、韩国学习者二语英语语音语料库、J-AESOP 及其组合上训练的岭回归模型。在由三位专家评分员独立评分的 305 条留出测试录音上，多个岭回归配置在全部三个评价维度上的 Spearman 相关系数和二次加权 Kappa 均显著优于存档的微软 Azure 发音评估 API 数据。这些结果表明，仅依靠预训练表征和针对特定评价维度的回归模型，即可在消费级硬件上实现专家级语音评估，无需对神经模型进行微调，也无需在私有评估数据上进行校准。
tldr: 该研究提出了一个可在消费级游戏电脑上本地运行的二语英语发音评估系统 oollim，仅使用预训练语音表征和岭回归，就在准确性、流利度和韵律评估上显著超越微软 Azure API，达到专家级水平。
en_tdlr: This paper presents oollim, a locally executable L2 English pronunciation evaluation system that uses only pretrained speech representations and ridge regressions to achieve expert-level assessment of accuracy, fluency, and prosody on consumer hardware, substantially outperforming Microsoft Azure's Pronunciation Assessment API.
